home_subtitle: 第四课 · 大树的记忆
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：跟站长去看老树的年轮，学 contain、particular、chemistry 等新词，用条件句和 unless 读《树的记忆》（上）；练习里掺着挑战题，边学边闯。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：独立判断《树的记忆》（下），看科学家用年轮查古火灾、算老房子的年代；课尾压轴：since/for、被动、现在完成时回锅，条件句与 unless 综合产出。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：条件句（2）与 unless 的综合运用（科学语境：年轮宽窄、火灾痕迹）、unless 改写、构词 -ize（memory→memorize）；挑战段回锅 since/for、被动语态、现在完成时。Unit 7 The secret of memory 主题，核心词 contain/particular/chemistry/natural disaster/figure out/scar，复现 summary/image/visual/tend/loss。

steps.title: 新节目：去看一棵老树
steps.teach_html:
广播站这次做户外节目：站长带大家去看村口的一棵老树。老树被风吹倒后锯开了，树干里面一圈一圈的，这就是年轮。

站长说：树也有记忆。年轮一圈就是一年，宽窄、黑斑都记着那一年发生的事。这一课，我们用条件句和 unless 把大树的记忆一句一句读出来。

steps.title: 条件句：谈必然结果
steps.teach_html:
先把老规矩拿出来：谈必然结果（科学事实、自然规律），用 If + 一般现在时，主句一般现在时，两边都不用 will。

If a tree gets enough rain, its ring is wide.（雨水够，年轮就宽。）

If a year is dry, the ring is narrow.（那一年干旱，年轮就窄。）主语是 a tree / a year 这类单数时，动词记得加 s：gets、is。

steps.title: unless 综合：等于 if...not
steps.teach_html:
unless 是这一课的综合工具：unless = if...not，意思是“除非；如果不”。

Unless a tree gets water, it grows slowly.（除非树得到水，否则它长得慢。）= If a tree does not get water, it grows slowly.

记住一条铁律：用了 unless，从句里不再加 not。别写成 Unless a tree does not get water，那就错了。

steps.title: 年轮里的科学
steps.teach_html:
年轮怎么读？一年一圈：数一数有多少圈，就知道树活了多少年。

宽圈 = 那一年雨水足；窄圈 = 那一年干旱；圈上的黑斑 = 那一年发生过火灾。

把这些事实说成条件句：If the ring is wide, the year was wet. 科学家就是这样用年轮查古时候的火灾、算老房子的年代的。

steps.title: 生词一：contain 和 particular
steps.teach_html:
contain /kənˈteɪn/ 是“包含；含有”：The tree contains a long story.（这棵树里藏着一个长长的故事。）主语是单数时用 contains。

particular /pəˈtɪkjələ/ 是“专指的；特指的”：this particular ring（专指这一圈），不是泛指所有圈。

steps.title: 生词二：chemistry 和 natural disaster
steps.teach_html:
chemistry /ˈkemɪstri/ 是“化学”：Tree chemistry tells us about dry years.（树的化学成分会告诉我们哪些年干旱。）

natural disaster 是“自然灾害”：火灾、干旱、洪水都是 natural disasters。年轮连自然灾害都记着。

steps.title: 短语 figure out 和脚注词 scar
steps.teach_html:
figure out 是老朋友了，意思是“弄明白；算出来”：figure out the tree's age（算出树的年龄）。

再认识一个脚注词：scar /skɑː/ 是“伤疤”。人身上的伤疤记着受过的伤；年轮上的黑斑就是树的 scar，记着一场大火。

steps.title: 构词点：memory 加 -ize 变 memorize
steps.teach_html:
一个小构词点：名词后面加 -ize，可以变成动词。

memory（记忆，名词）+ -ize → memorize /ˈmeməraɪz/（背诵；记住，动词）。

If you memorize the words, you remember them in the test. 这只是词汇扩展，记住这一对就够了。

steps.title: 易混点：三个坑
steps.teach_html:
练之前提醒三个坑：

坑一：unless 后面不加 not。Unless it rains 本身就是“如果不下雨”。

坑二：谈必然结果不用 will：If a year is wet, the ring is wide.

坑三：主语是单数（a tree、the ring、the wood），动词加 s：contains、gets、shows。

steps.title: 先看资料：树的记忆（上）
steps.teach_html:
这是站长在老树旁边念的短文《树的记忆》（上）。做题时对照着看：年轮一年一圈，宽圈雨水足、窄圈干旱、黑斑是火灾。

下面站长带着你练。
steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 雨水足，圈就宽
steps.scene: 雨水充足的那一年，年轮宽。
steps.stem: If a year is wet, the ring ___ wide.
steps.help: 主语是 the ring（一个圈），be 动词选哪个？
steps.explain: If a year is wet, the ring is wide. 主语 the ring 是单数，用 is；谈必然结果不用 will。

wrong_feedback.B: are 是给复数主语用的；the ring 是一个圈，用 is。
wrong_feedback.C: 谈必然结果不用 will，而且 will 后面也不能跟 is 这样搭。
wrong_feedback.D: be 是原形，不能直接放在单数主语后面，要用 is。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 树里藏着故事
steps.scene: 老树的年轮里包含着长长的故事。
steps.stem: The old tree ___ a long story in its rings.
steps.help: 哪个词是刚学的“包含；含有”？主语是单数，动词还要加 s。
steps.explain: The old tree contains a long story in its rings. contain 是“包含；含有”，主语单数用 contains。

wrong_feedback.A: tend 是“往往会”，后面跟 to do，不表示“包含”。
wrong_feedback.C: figure 要和 out 连用才是“弄明白”，这里要的是“包含”：contains。
wrong_feedback.D: summarize 是“总结”，说的是人写总结，不是树里“含有”故事。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 除非得到水
steps.scene: 除非树得到水，否则它长得慢。
steps.stem: Unless a tree ___ enough water, it grows slowly. (get)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 得到（主语是 a tree，单数）

steps.help: 先看主语：a tree 是一棵树。unless 从句里的动词要不要加 s？
steps.explain: Unless a tree gets enough water, it grows slowly. 主语 a tree 是第三人称单数，get 加 s；unless 本身已经带“不”的意思，后面不用 not。

common_errors.say: 主语 a tree 是单数，动词要加 s：gets。
unless 本身就等于 if...not，后面再加 not 就重复了，直接用 gets。
谈必然结果用一般现在时，不用 will。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 干旱年，圈就窄
steps.scene: 那一年干旱，年轮就窄。
steps.stem: If a year ___ dry, the ring is narrow. (be)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 是（主语是 a year，单数）

steps.help: 主语是 a year（一年），算单数还是复数？谈的是规律，用现在还是过去？
steps.explain: If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. 主语 a year 是单数，用 is；谈规律用一般现在时。

common_errors.say: are 是给复数主语用的；a year 是单数，用 is。
was 是过去式；这句谈的是规律，用一般现在时 is。
be 是原形，单数主语后面要用 is。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: particular 的意思
steps.scene: particular 意思是？
steps.stem: The word "particular" means ___.
steps.help: 回想生词课：this particular ring 指的是泛指还是专指这一圈？
steps.explain: particular 意思是“专指的；特指的”。

wrong_feedback.A: “化学”是 chemistry。particular 说的是“专指某一个”。
wrong_feedback.B: “自然灾害”是 natural disaster。particular 是“特指的”。
wrong_feedback.C: “伤疤”是 scar。particular 是“专指的；特指的”。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 数圈知年龄
steps.scene: 数一数年轮，就知道树的年龄。
steps.stem: If you ___ (count) the rings, you ___ (know) the tree's age.
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。
steps.help: 两个空的主语都是 you。you 后面的动词加 s 还是用原形？
steps.explain: If you count the rings, you know the tree's age. 主语 you 用动词原形：count、know 都不加 s。

common_errors.say: 主语是 you，动词不加 s；counts 是给 he / she 用的。
主语还是 you，know 用原形，不加 s。
谈必然结果不用 will，主句也是一般现在时。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 算出年龄
steps.scene: 科学家算出了这棵树的年龄。
steps.stem: Scientists can ___ the tree's age from the rings. (figure out)
steps.task: 写出空里的短语。
steps.help: 这个短语是两个词：figure 加上一个小词，意思是“算出来”。
steps.explain: Scientists can figure out the tree's age from the rings. figure out 是“弄明白；算出来”。

common_errors.say: 少了 out。figure out 是一个整体短语，两个词都要写。
find out 偏向“查明消息”；课上算年龄用的短语是 figure out。
can 后面用动词原形：figure out，不能加 s。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 树的化学
steps.scene: 树的化学成分能告诉我们干旱的年份。
steps.stem: ___ helps scientists learn about dry years.
steps.help: 哪个词是“化学”？它是一门科学的名字。
steps.explain: Chemistry helps scientists learn about dry years. chemistry 是“化学”。

wrong_feedback.A: summary 是“总结”，是写出来的短文，不是这门科学。
wrong_feedback.D: visual 是“视觉的”，是形容词；这里要的是学科名 chemistry。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 圈窄除非下雨
steps.scene: 年轮窄，除非那一年下雨多。
steps.stem: A ring is narrow ___ the year is wet.
steps.task: 只写空里的一个词。
steps.help: 把 if 放进去读一读：意思通吗？这句话要的是“除非……否则就窄”。
steps.explain: A ring is narrow unless the year is wet. unless = if...not：如果那一年不湿，年轮就窄。

common_errors.say: if 是“如果”：如果那年湿，圈就窄——意思反了。要用 unless。
when 说的是时间“当……时”；这里是条件“除非”，用 unless。
because 说原因；这里前后是条件关系，用 unless。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 哪句是对的
steps.scene: 下面哪一句条件句写对了？
steps.stem: Which sentence is right?
options: Unless it does not rain, the ring is narrow.
Unless it rains, the ring is narrow.
If it will rain, the ring is wide.
The ring will is wide if it rains.
steps.help: 一条一条查：unless 后面有没有多余的 not？if 从句里有没有 will？
steps.explain: Unless it rains, the ring is narrow. unless 本身等于 if...not，后面不能再加 not；谈必然结果不用 will。

wrong_feedback.A: unless 后面又加了 does not，“不”说了两遍，意思乱了。
wrong_feedback.C: if 从句里不能用 will；谈必然结果用一般现在时：If it rains。
wrong_feedback.D: will is 不是正确搭配，而且必然结果根本不用 will：the ring is wide。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 树上的伤疤
steps.scene: 年轮上的黑斑是树的一道伤疤。
steps.stem: The black ___ on the ring shows an old fire.
steps.task: 只写空里的一个词（脚注词）。
steps.help: 脚注词：人身上留下的伤痕叫什么？树上的黑斑就是树的这个词。
steps.explain: The black scar on the ring shows an old fire. scar 是“伤疤”。

common_errors.say: 前面有 The black 单数提示，这里指一道伤疤，用单数 scar。
fire 是“火”本身；空里要的是“伤疤”这个词：scar。
黑斑是树的伤疤，不是故事；表示伤疤的词是 scar。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 老树长得慢
steps.scene: 老树往往会长得越来越慢。
steps.stem: Old trees ___ to grow more slowly year by year. (tend)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 往往会（主语是复数 Old trees）

steps.help: 主语 Old trees 是单棵还是多棵？复数主语的动词加不加 s？
steps.explain: Old trees tend to grow more slowly year by year. 主语 Old trees 是复数，tend 用原形。tend to do 是“往往会做某事”。

common_errors.say: tends 是给单数主语用的；Old trees 是复数，用原形 tend。
tended 是过去式；这句谈的是普遍规律，用一般现在时。
tend 后面要跟 to：tend to grow，to 不能丢。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 什么是自然灾害
steps.scene: 森林大火属于哪一类？
steps.stem: A forest fire is a kind of ___.
steps.help: 刚学过的短语：火灾、干旱、洪水这一类，合起来叫什么？
steps.explain: A forest fire is a kind of natural disaster. natural disaster 是“自然灾害”。

wrong_feedback.B: visual image 是“视觉图像”，说的是画面，不是灾害。
wrong_feedback.C: short summary 是“简短总结”，和火灾不是一类。
wrong_feedback.D: memory loss 是“记忆丧失”，是记忆问题，不是自然灾害。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 背住这些词
steps.scene: 测验前把年轮的词背住。
steps.stem: Please ___ these ring words before the quiz. (memorize)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 背诵；记住（Please 后用原形）

steps.help: Please 后面跟动词原形。这个词是 memory 加 -ize 变来的动词。
steps.explain: Please memorize these ring words before the quiz. memorize 是 memory 加 -ize 变成的动词“背诵；记住”；Please 后面用原形。

common_errors.say: memory 是名词“记忆”，这里需要动词“背住”：memorize。
Please 后面用动词原形，不加 s：memorize。

common_errors.when: 写了 remember 的其他拼写错误
common_errors.say: 这里要用构词课的新词 memorize，不是 remember。

steps.reading: An old tree in our town was cut down last week. Inside it, people saw many circles. Each circle is one year of the tree's life. If a year is wet, the ring is wide. If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 看得见的记录
steps.scene: 年轮的照片是一种看得见的记录。
steps.stem: A photo of the rings is a ___ record of the tree's life.
steps.help: 哪个词和“看”有关，是“视觉的”？
steps.explain: A photo of the rings is a visual record of the tree's life. visual 是“视觉的”。

wrong_feedback.A: summary 是“总结”，是文字概括，不是照片这种看得见的记录。
wrong_feedback.D: particular 是“特指的”，修饰“专指某一个”，不表示“看得见”。

If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 挑战 · 读短文：黑斑
steps.scene: 根据短文《树的记忆》（上）回答。
steps.stem: According to the text, what does a black scar on a ring mean?
steps.help: 回到短文里找 scar 那一句：A scar means a ...？
steps.explain: A fire happened long ago. 短文原话：A scar means a fire long ago.（黑斑表示很久以前的一场火。）

wrong_feedback.A: 雨水足对应的是宽圈，不是黑斑。
wrong_feedback.B: 干旱对应的是窄圈，不是黑斑。
wrong_feedback.C: 树被砍下是故事的开头，不是黑斑的意思。

If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 写个总结
steps.scene: 课最后，老师让大家给树的故事写个简短总结。
steps.stem: At the end, write a short ___ of the tree's story.
steps.task: 只写空里的一个词。
steps.help: a short ___ of...：要一个名词，意思是“总结”。刚在选项里见过它。
steps.explain: At the end, write a short summary of the tree's story. summary 是名词“总结；摘要”。

common_errors.say: summarize 是动词；a short 后面要跟名词 summary。
story 是“故事”本身；空里要的是“总结”：summary。
注意拼写：summary 最后一个字母是 y，不是 e。

If a year is dry, the ring is narrow. Some rings have black scars. A scar means a fire long ago. The tree contains a long story. If you count the rings, you figure out how old the tree is.

steps.title: 新任务：独立判断
steps.teach_html:
新任务：短文《树的记忆》（下）在上面。这次讲科学家怎么用年轮查一场古火灾、算一座老房子的年代。

这次你自己看、自己答，站长不提示了。记住：unless = if...not，从句里不再加 not；谈必然结果不用 will。
steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 黑斑那一年
steps.scene: 有黑斑的那一年，发生过一场火。
steps.stem: If a ring has a black scar, a fire ___ that year.
steps.help: 那是过去某一年发生过的事，用什么时态？
steps.explain: If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. 短文讲的是过去那一年的事，用过去式 happened。

wrong_feedback.B: happen 是原形；主语 a fire 是单数，而且说的是过去的事，要用 happened。
wrong_feedback.C: 短文说的是已经发生过的火，不用 will。
wrong_feedback.D: happening 是 -ing 形式，不能单独做谓语。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战 · 除非仔细查
steps.scene: 除非科学家仔细查，否则会漏掉这些小 marks。
steps.stem: Unless scientists ___ carefully, they miss these small marks. (check)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。
steps.help: 主语 scientists 是一位还是多位？unless 后面还要不要加 not？
steps.explain: Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. 主语 scientists 是复数，用原形 check；unless 后面不加 not。

common_errors.say: 主语 scientists 是复数，动词用原形 check，不加 s。
unless 本身就带“不”的意思，再加 do not 就重复了。
checked 是过去式；这句谈的是规律，用一般现在时 check。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 房子是哪年建的
steps.scene: 他们算出了这座房子建成的年份。
steps.stem: They figure out the year the house ___.
steps.help: 房子是自己建自己，还是被人建的？再看：说的是过去建成的事。
steps.explain: They figure out the year the house was built. 房子是被建的，用被动；建成是过去的事，用 was built。

wrong_feedback.A: build 是主动原形；房子是被建的，要用被动。
wrong_feedback.B: builds 还是主动，而且时态也不对。
wrong_feedback.D: building 是 -ing 形式，组不成“被建成”的意思。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 木头里含有
steps.scene: 如果木头里含有特殊的东西，那年就特别。
steps.stem: If the wood ___ special things, the year was special. (contain)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 含有（主语是 the wood，单数）

steps.help: 主语 the wood 算单数还是复数？单数主语的动词要加什么？
steps.explain: If the wood contains special things, the year was special. 主语 the wood 是单数，contain 加 s。

common_errors.say: 主语 the wood 是单数，动词要加 s：contains。
contained 是过去式；if 从句谈条件用一般现在时 contains。
is 后面不能直接跟原形这样搭；一般现在时直接用 contains。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 专指的那一圈
steps.scene: 他们只研究专指的那一圈，不是所有的圈。
steps.stem: They study one ___ ring, not all of them.
steps.help: 哪个词是“专指的；特指的”？句子里有 not all of them 在帮你排除泛指。
steps.explain: They study one particular ring, not all of them. particular 是“专指的；特指的”。

wrong_feedback.A: general 是“一般的、泛指的”，和 not all of them 正好矛盾。
wrong_feedback.C: natural 是“自然的”，常和 disaster 连用，不是“特指的”。
wrong_feedback.D: visual 是“视觉的”，说的是看得见，和“专指”无关。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战 · 他数圈
steps.scene: 科学家数了年轮，就知道了树的年龄。
steps.stem: If a scientist ___ (count) the rings, he ___ (learn) the tree's age.
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。

cn: 数（主语是 a scientist，单数）

steps.help: 两个空的主语都是单数：a scientist 和 he。单数主语的动词都要发生什么变化？
steps.explain: If a scientist counts the rings, he learns the tree's age. 两个主语都是第三人称单数，count 和 learn 都加 s。

common_errors.say: 主语 a scientist 是一个科学家，动词要加 s：counts。
主语还是 he，learn 也要加 s：learns。
谈必然结果不用 will，主句用一般现在时 learns。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 树的化学帮忙
steps.scene: 树的化学成分也能帮忙。
steps.stem: Tree ___ also helps scientists learn about the past.
steps.task: 只写空里的一个词。
steps.help: 哪个词是学科名“化学”？前面有 Tree，后面是 also helps。
steps.explain: Tree chemistry also helps scientists learn about the past. chemistry 是“化学”。

common_errors.say: chemical 是形容词或“化学品”；这里要学科名 chemistry。
chemist 是“化学家”（人）；这里说的是树的化学成分，用 chemistry。
注意拼写：chemistry，中间是 -mist-。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 哪个是自然灾害
steps.scene: 下面哪一个是自然灾害？
steps.stem: Which of the following is a natural disaster?
steps.help: natural disaster 是“自然灾害”。四件事里，哪一件是大自然带来的灾难？
steps.explain: A forest fire. 森林大火是 natural disaster（自然灾害）。

wrong_feedback.A: 生日派对是开心的事，不是灾害。
wrong_feedback.B: 建房子是人的活动，不是自然灾害。
wrong_feedback.C: 学校旅行是活动，不是灾害。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 老房子的图像
steps.scene: 老房子的图像帮他们比对木头。
steps.stem: The ___ of the old house helps them match the wood. (image)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。
steps.help: 提示词就是要填的词本身。前面有 The，后面是 of，填单数还是复数？
steps.explain: The image of the old house helps them match the wood. image 是“图像”，这里用单数。

common_errors.say: 后面 helps 是单数动词，前面主语也要单数：image。
意思接近，但本课的复现词是 image，按提示词写 image。
注意拼写：image，i-m-a-g-e。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战 · 哪句是对的
steps.scene: 下面哪一句写对了？
steps.stem: Which sentence is right?
options: Unless scientists do not check, they miss the marks.
If scientists will check carefully, they miss nothing.
Scientists miss the marks unless they check carefully.
Scientists will misses the marks unless they check.
steps.help: 查三点：unless 后有没有多余的 not？if 里有没有 will？动词形式对不对？
steps.explain: Scientists miss the marks unless they check carefully. unless 从句放在后面不用逗号；unless 后面不加 not。

wrong_feedback.A: unless 后面又加了 do not，“不”重复了。
wrong_feedback.B: if 从句里不能用 will；而且 miss nothing 和前半意思也对不上。
wrong_feedback.D: will 后面要用原形 miss，不能写 misses；谈规律也不用 will。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战 · 除非被保护
steps.scene: 除非老树被保护起来，否则很多会被砍掉。
steps.stem: ___ old trees are protected, many are cut down.
steps.task: 只写空里的一个词（首字母大写）。
steps.help: 这句话前半是“除非……”的条件。要填的词本身就带着“如果不”的意思。
steps.explain: Unless old trees are protected, many are cut down. Unless = if...not：如果老树得不到保护，很多就会被砍掉。

common_errors.say: If 是“如果”：如果老树被保护，很多被砍掉——意思反了。要用 Unless。
When 说时间；这里是条件“除非”，用 Unless。
Because 说原因；这里前后是条件关系，用 Unless。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 怎么算出房子的年代
steps.scene: 科学家怎么算出老房子是哪年建的？
steps.stem: How do scientists figure out when an old house was built?
options: They match its wood with old tree rings.
They ask the house some questions.
They count the rooms in the house.
They paint the wood a new colour.
steps.help: 回到短文找 figure out 那一段：they match its wood with ...？
steps.explain: They match its wood with old tree rings. 短文说：科学家把房子的木头和老树的年轮比对，就算出了建成年份。

wrong_feedback.B: 房子不会回答问题；短文说的是比对木头和年轮。
wrong_feedback.C: 数房间数算不出年份；关键是比对年轮。
wrong_feedback.D: 给木头刷颜色和算年代没有关系。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 老树的丧失
steps.scene: 老树的丧失是这座小镇的一个问题。
steps.stem: The ___ of old trees is a problem for the town. (loss)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。
steps.help: The ___ of...：这里要名词还是动词？提示词 loss 本身就是名词。
steps.explain: The loss of old trees is a problem for the town. loss 是名词“丧失”。

common_errors.say: lose 是动词“失去”；The 后面、of 前面要放名词 loss。
lost 是 lose 的过去式/过去分词，也是动词形式，这里要用名词 loss。
注意拼写：loss 是双写 s。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 干旱年出窄圈
steps.scene: 干旱的年份往往会形成窄圈。
steps.stem: Dry years ___ to make narrow rings. (tend)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 往往会（主语是复数 Dry years）

steps.help: 主语 Dry years 是复数。tend to do 还记得吗？
steps.explain: Dry years tend to make narrow rings. 主语 Dry years 是复数，tend 用原形。

common_errors.say: tends 是给单数主语用的；Dry years 是复数，用 tend。
这句谈的是规律，用一般现在时，不用过去式。

common_errors.when: 漏了后面的 to 搭配
common_errors.say: tend 后面跟 to do：tend to make，to 是这个短语的一部分。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战 · 黑圈讲火灾
steps.scene: 如果一圈是黑的，它就讲述了一场古火灾。
steps.stem: If a ring ___ (be) black, it ___ (show) an old fire.
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。

cn: 是（主语是 a ring，单数）
显示；讲述（主语是 it，单数）

steps.help: 两个空的主语都是单数：a ring 和 it。be 动词选哪个？show 要不要加 s？
steps.explain: If a ring is black, it shows an old fire. 主语都是第三人称单数：be 用 is，show 加 s。

common_errors.say: a ring 是一个圈（单数），be 动词用 is。
主语 it 是单数，show 要加 s：shows。
谈必然结果不用 will，用一般现在时 shows。

steps.reading: Scientists study tree rings to learn about the past. If a house is very old, they match its wood with old tree rings. Then they figure out the year the house was built. Rings also show natural disasters. If a ring has a black scar, a fire happened that year. Unless scientists check carefully, they miss these small marks. Tree chemistry also helps: if the wood contains special things, the tree lived through a dry or dirty year.

steps.title: 挑战预告：老朋友回锅
steps.teach_html: 独立判断过关！接下来是挑战关：since/for、被动语态、现在完成时几位老朋友回锅，最后两题要把条件句和 unless 合在一起产出句子。站长只给方向提示。

steps.title: 挑战 · 站了近百年
steps.scene: 这棵老树从 1920 年起就立在这里。
steps.stem: This old tree has stood here ___ 1920.
steps.help: 1920 是一个年份：是时间点，还是一段时间？
steps.explain: This old tree has stood here since 1920. since + 时间点；for + 时间段。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟时间段（如 for 100 years）；1920 是时间点，用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 只说起点，不表示一直持续到现在，用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: in 1920 是“在 1920 年”，那是过去时的说法；持续到现在用 since。

steps.title: 挑战 · 老树被锯倒
steps.scene: 上周，老树被锯倒了。
steps.stem: The old tree ___ down last week.
steps.help: 树是自己锯自己，还是被人锯倒的？last week 是过去还是现在？
steps.explain: The old tree was cut down last week. 树是被锯倒的，用被动；last week 是过去，用 was cut。

wrong_feedback.A: 只写 cut 是主动过去式；树是被锯的，要用被动 was cut。
wrong_feedback.C: cuts 是一般现在时单数；时间和语态都不对。
wrong_feedback.D: cutting 是 -ing 形式，组不成被动。

steps.title: 挑战 · 研究了很多年
steps.scene: 科学家们研究这棵树很多年了。
steps.stem: Scientists ___ this tree for many years. (study)
steps.task: 用所给词的正确形式填空，只写空里的部分。

cn: 已经研究了（现在完成时，主语复数）

steps.help: for many years + 一直到现在：用哪个时态？主语 Scientists 是复数，have 还是 has？
steps.explain: Scientists have studied this tree for many years. 从过去研究到现在，用现在完成时；主语复数用 have studied。

common_errors.say: studied 只说过去研究过；for many years 一直持续到现在，要用 have studied。
主语 Scientists 是复数，用 have，不用 has。
have 后面要用过去分词 studied，不能用原形。

steps.title: 挑战 · 圈窄除非下雨
steps.scene: 用条件句和 unless 产出：年轮是窄的，除非下雨。
steps.stem: The ring ___ (be) narrow unless it ___ (rain).
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。

cn: 是（主语是 The ring，单数）

steps.help: 主句主语 The ring 是单数；unless 从句的主语 it 也是单数。两个动词都要照顾单数。
steps.explain: The ring is narrow unless it rains. 主语都是第三人称单数：be 用 is，rain 加 s。

common_errors.say: The ring 是一个圈，be 动词用 is。
unless 从句的主语是 it（单数），rain 要加 s：rains。

common_errors.when: 在 unless 后面加了 not
common_errors.say: unless 本身就带“不”的意思，后面不用再加 not。

steps.title: 挑战 · 没水就死
steps.scene: 用 unless 写完整条件：植物得不到水就会死。
steps.stem: Unless plants ___ (get) water, they ___ (die).
steps.task: 两个空都用所给词的正确形式填，只写两个空里的部分，中间空一格。
steps.help: 两个空的主语都是复数：plants 和 they。复数主语的动词加 s 吗？unless 后面还要 not 吗？
steps.explain: Unless plants get water, they die. 主语都是复数，动词用原形；unless 已经带“不”的意思，不再加 not。

common_errors.say: 主语 plants 是复数，动词用原形 get。

common_errors.when: 第一个空写了 do not get
common_errors.say: unless 本身等于 if...not，多写 do not 就重复了。
主语 they 是复数，die 用原形，不加 s。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
大树的记忆读完了：年轮一年一圈，条件句说清宽窄，unless 说清“除非”。树的 scar 记着火，树的 chemistry 记着干旱——一棵树，就是一本写了一百年的书。

下一课，站长带你走进记忆的最后一站，敬请期待。

title: 大树的记忆：条件句综合
